title: aristida micrantha
intro: Aristida micrantha, commonly known as Small Exogyne or Small Spinegrass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Aristida micrantha include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
